description: Lists the sitemaps submitted for the site in Search Console, with when Google last read each one, errors, warnings and how many URLs it contains. Use for indexing questions about many pages at once. Read-only; it does not submit or change sitemaps.

site.description: The Search Console property to read. Accepts "example.com", "https://example.com/" or "sc-domain:example.com". Call list_sites first if unsure which properties exist.

name: sitemaps
title: Sitemap status
